question: According to Proverbs 2:21-22, what is the difference between the upright and the wicked?
options: The upright will be poor; the wicked will be rich
The upright will live in the land; the wicked will be cut off from it
The upright will travel; the wicked will stay home
explanation: Proverbs 2:21-22 says the upright will live in the land, but the wicked will be cut off from the land.
